title: Belkin F8M747 Black Automatically Wireless Charging Pad (tested) W/ Cord
categoryName: Cell Phones & Accessories:Cell Phone Accessories:Chargers & Cradles
descriptionText:
Introducing the Belkin F8M747 Black Automatically Wireless Charging Pad, a modern and convenient accessory for your Samsung Galaxy S6 edge, S6, S7, or Galaxy Note 7. This charging pad comes with an 8m charging cable and a wireless charging standard of Qi. 

With its automatic charging feature, you can simply place your phone on the charging pad and it will start charging without the need for any cords or cables. This charging pad is compatible with universal brands and has a sleek black color that will complement any modern theme. It also has a single port and is manufactured in China. Get this wireless charging pad today and enjoy a convenient and hassle-free charging experience.
